response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), overall AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(s.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * s.invoice_count / o.total_invoices) AS average_share, AVG(s.invoice_count - o.average_count) AS average_above_average FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.invoice_count > o.average_count
